To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a compact, low noise readout system based upon commercially available application-specific-integrated-circuit (ASIC) technology has been developed.

a prototype detector module based on a LSO scintillator crystal coupled to APD arrays and readout by a custom ASIC shows good energy resolution, and the ASIC shows excellent performance for use in a high performance PET system.

a compact, low noise and low cost read-out system based on commercial application specific integrated circuits (ASIC) is under investigation for use in a dedicated high performance PET breast imaging system.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of high sensitivity and low cost PET systems for breast cancer imaging.
the design, fabrication and testing of a dedicated high performance PET system.
the development of a compact, low cost, and low power consumption readout system for a high performance breast imaging positron emission tomography system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ASICs are a viable option for readout of the proposed PET system.
the proposed ASICs can provide a very promising low-cost and high performance front-end readout solution for the proposed high sensitivity PET system.
a prototype APD-based detector system with a dedicated readout ASIC has been built and tested.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed system is a good choice for a low-cost, low-power, high-performance, high-resolution PET system.
we have developed a prototype PET system based on a new detector module comprising LSO scintillation crystals and avalanche photodiode array.
we have developed a low noise readout system based upon a custom designed ASIC and have demonstrated that this system can be used to obtain high performance in a PET imaging system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to develop a dedicated, low cost, low noise, compact, high performance PET system based on APDs and commercially available ASICs.
the ASICs are capable of achieving a noise level of 10 e/sup -/ for a 1 M/spl Sigma/ input signal.
the ASIC can serve as a foundation to build a dedicated breast PET system.
